name: Backend API + Models
description: Créer FastAPI backend: models SQLAlchemy (Lead, Campaign, Content, Conversation, AnalyticsEvent), schemas Pydantic, routes CRUD pour /api/leads, /api/campaigns, /api/content, /api/analytics, /api/telegram/webhook. Config avec pydantic-settings. Database async avec asyncpg. Lazy-init pour les clients OpenAI/Qdrant (pas d'erreur sans API key). Le champ 'metadata' du model Lead doit s'appeler 'extra_data' (SQLAlchemy reserve 'metadata').

name: Lead Scoring + Telegram Bot + RAG
description: Créer les agents IA: lead_scoring.py (LLM gpt-4o-mini pour scorer 0-100, update lead status si >= threshold), telegram_bot.py (closing agent gpt-4o avec RAG, webhook handler, send_telegram helper), rag_service.py (Qdrant + OpenAI embeddings, lazy-init clients, ensure_collection, store_memory, retrieve_scripts). Worker stub pour background tasks.

name: Dashboard Next.js
description: Créer dashboard Next.js: page.tsx (home), leads/page.tsx (table + filtres status/platform/score + score badges colorés), campaigns/page.tsx (CRUD + form new campaign), content/page.tsx (grid cards + filtres type + form), analytics/page.tsx (KPI cards + top campaigns table), conversion/page.tsx (funnel visuel + metrics). Next.config.js avec rewrites vers backend:8000.

name: Docker + DB + Seed + Tests + Alembic
description: Créer: docker-compose.yml (5 services: backend, postgres, qdrant, frontend, worker), db/init.sql (5 tables + indexes + triggers updated_at), backend/Dockerfile, backend/requirements.txt, .env template, backend/alembic/ (env.py, script.py.mako, alembic.ini), seed.py (3 campaigns, 10 leads, 7 content items demo data), tests/test_all.py (10 tests: models, schemas, prompts, config — tous doivent passer sans API key).
